title: SkillDefinition
description: One standard Agent Skill: its name, its root, and — for a skill a workspace added — the source it came from.

name.description: The standard Agent Skills name: Unicode lowercase or uncased letters and numbers joined by single hyphens, equal to the skill's directory name.

scope.description: Root: project `.agents/skills`, plurnk `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/plurnk/skills`, global `~/.agents/skills`, or a service-provided resource tree. Service skills are never added or removed.

source.description: Where an added skill comes from: a git remote as a full https or ssh URL, a folder, a lone SKILL.md, or a zip or tar archive. Required to add a skill.

ref.description: The branch or tag of a git source; the remote's default branch when absent.

commit.description: The commit a git source's ref named when the skill was added. The service records it; a client never supplies it.
